reference_selection_rule: Select a unique source sample per candidate phase, preferring an unseen non-manual reference pickle, quality 1, fewer phases, higher fitted phase weight, then sample ID.
query_selection_rule: Use every eligible active-scan reaction whose complete truth lies inside the top-20 library, except samples used to construct candidate reference profiles.

claim_correction.reason: The source was already used in the project's closed-library benchmark.
claim_correction.original_claim_boundary: Previously unused external measured retrospective holdout. One scan per physical reaction; repeated scans are not treated as independent samples.

claim_boundary: Previously used by this project in the closed-library benchmark. New for the open-library intervention, but not a fresh external source: 77 of 102 selected queries overlap the earlier 416-query cohort and 25 are new. One scan per physical reaction; repeated scans are not treated as independent samples.
